rule: This file records where shared LexicalOS learning/runtime work should continue. It is not lexical semantic truth, not private learner state, and not a substitute for LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, schema.json, or Natural Owners. A fresh Chat should read this cursor plus the referenced Current owners before proposing or continuing LexicalOS learning/runtime work.
completed_shared_work: LexicalOS Natural Owner cutover completed: 7,946 Word owners and 369 Relation owners are Current semantic authority.
The learner goal is frozen as fast, correct contextual lexical access rather than dictionary completion or one-card-per-sense review.

Main Study interaction is frozen around one rich Depth Card: Recall Map before Reveal, then Core/Word Feel plus high-value learner meanings, constructions/phrase skeletons, and only necessary contrasts.
Recall Map may use compact forms such as 3V + (2+1)A and phrase/construction skeletons. Counts are learner-worthy active meanings, not dictionary sense counts.
A genuinely rich familiar word may remain deep; learner value and scanability, not an arbitrary small sense cap, control Reveal depth.

The per-expansion + action is the main selective-repair interaction. It means that specific lexical object is not yet fast/stable/automatic enough; whole-word UNKNOWN/FUZZY/KNOW/PASS is not the default main-card judgment.
A + or observed lexical failure creates a repair target, not a permanent fixed flashcard. One target may generate multiple challenge surfaces over time without multiplying permanent cards.
Challenge is dynamic and may be freely generated from Current semantics. It must not consume unattempted true-exam/TPO/held-out unseen sentences that are more valuable as later transfer evidence.
For up to four Challenge choices, spatial arrow-key answers are the preferred high-speed interaction; the arrow selects and submits directly without a second Enter confirmation.

Blind probes are allowed only selectively to catch familiarity illusion. Correct blind probes should normally disappear without creating review debt; failures activate only the affected lexical object.
Evidence strength is ordered from isolated recall toward later unseen-context success; real transfer evidence outranks repeated artificial card success.
Memory admission is selective: 7,946 Main Words and their active meanings must not become permanent review debt. Stable simple knowledge fades dormant and reactivates only on counterevidence.

Daily Return Packet is frozen as a mandatory input to the next learning day. Meaningful +, wrong, slow/fuzzy, repeated failure, bad-question, or semantic-error evidence must change the next packet/repair plan rather than being archived passively.

Daily Challenge scheduling is evidence-compiled rather than due-card based: previous-day wrong/Again first, then explicit +, then slow/fuzzy, then older unresolved targets, with blind probes only as a small residual layer.

A new + normally receives its first real Challenge on the next learning day rather than an immediate same-card retest. Wrong/Again gets smallest repair plus at most one same-session reconstruction and must return the next learning day.
A clean next-day result can leave immediate obligation; later fresh Challenge or real-context success may move the target dormant. Missed calendar days must not manufacture an overdue pile.

Return Packet minimum evidence is owner-referential: word identity plus the precise sense/collocation/relation or other stable owner-local target, evidence source, observable outcome, and question trace only when needed for diagnosis.

Current Astro VocabularyWordRuntime now uses Depth Scan rather than whole-word 1-4 ratings: Recall Map, Reveal, per-sense/collocation/construction/relation + Repair capture, keyboard selection, and Copy Return Packet are implemented for the existing single-word prototype.
VocabularyBrowser now presents Study / Search / Review and reads local Repair targets instead of whole-word rating history.

A shared learner packet contract now defines kianos.lexical.return_packet.v1 and kianos.lexical.challenge_packet.v1. Challenge Packet is private day-specific material generated by Chat, not a prebuilt lexical question bank or semantic owner.

next_action.instruction: Add the smallest client-side Challenge Packet runner to the Current Astro vocabulary prototype. It should import kianos.lexical.challenge_packet.v1, render 2-4 spatial choices, accept arrow-key direct submission, show minimal repair only after failure, optionally run one reconstruction item, collect challenge outcomes into Return Packet evidence, and never require a pre-authored question for every lexical object. Keep Challenge packet material private/local. After that, validate the Depth -> + -> export -> Chat compile -> import Challenge -> answer -> return loop on a few Current words before scaling beyond the answer prototype.
constraints: Do not invent +1 familiar-new branches in Astro from weak heuristics merely to satisfy the Recall Map design.
Do not create a second lexical semantic store for learner interaction or generated questions.
Do not require one pre-authored question per lexical sense or construction.
Do not make every active lexical object pass mandatory First Contact / First Retrieval / Transfer gates.
Do not let a fixed spaced-repetition interval outrank fresh learner evidence.
Do not leak held-out true-exam/TPO/unseen material into generated Challenge.
Do not expand learner-facing taxonomy merely because backend repair objects are fine-grained.
Keep the main learner interaction keyboard-fast and preserve + as the explicit selective-repair action.
next_action.success_condition: One real local loop can run end to end: a precise lexical branch is added with +, exported in a Return Packet, compiled by Chat into a generated Challenge Packet, imported into Astro, answered by spatial arrow keys, and returned as evidence for the next day without creating a fixed review-card queue.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not revert to one-word one-rating UNKNOWN/FUZZY/KNOW/PASS as the main learner model.
Do not turn every sense/construction/relation into a separate mandatory learner card.
Do not equate lexical richness with dictionary completeness.
Do not remove the Recall Map merely because Core is familiar; its job is to expose hidden depth behind familiarity illusion.
Do not make + mean only completely unknown; it also covers slow, fuzzy, passively known, unstable, or productive-needed objects.
Do not use unattempted true-exam/TPO/held-out unseen sentences as ordinary Challenge material.
Do not treat a defective generated question as learner failure.
Do not preserve artificial review when stronger later real-context evidence has already demonstrated access.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update at meaningful LexicalOS shared-work stage transitions or when the next active learning/runtime action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, learner/packet-contract.json, and only the smallest Current Natural Owner/runtime files needed by next_action. Continue from next_action rather than reconstructing the learning design from prior chats.
